financial_backfill.method: As-filed observations are filtered again at each event public clock. Missing XBRL is unknown; foreign/custom-tag data need separate source review.

market_data.identity_warning: Raw-symbol histories can include ticker reuse; dated issuer continuity remains required. Not NBBO or proof of fills.

obligation_audit.scope: Five-session base fixed models, both target sizes; deduplicated event obligations. Amounts use the largest modeled position, not a combined portfolio.

policy.name: Post-split five-session research
policy.entry: First regular-session open after bound public timestamp + five minutes; split baseline also waits until the session after the effective action.
policy.observations: Fresh public borrow indications inform research only, never approve a loan.
policy.source_gate: Bound issuer, accession and publication clock. Financing requires reconciled registered issued-common supply and cash pressure; completed split requires verified action.
policy.risk: One position per issuer; +200% stress loss reserve <=2% of hypothetical $10m NAV; margin headroom 20%; no live capital authority.
policy.parameter_selection: Chosen after exploratory historical comparisons. Future observations cannot change this version.
policy.promotion: New version required for any rule change; execution calibration and independent forward evidence required before production.
